lines.zh: : 那是在你们俩在一起之前！我试着告诉过你，可……你对那家伙的感情把你他妈的眼睛都蒙住了，我不想伤你的心！

lines.en: : I’m not buying it, Yumi. The more you speak, the more it’s starting to sound like this is some big ole’ convenient backstory you came up with in the event you got caught.
lines.zh: : 我不信，Yumi。你说得越多，越像是你为了防备被抓包而编好的一套顺理成章的说辞。

lines.en: : At the end of the day, I saw you two curled up together. I heard you ask to go back to his room. And I’ve already had my suspicions about {i}him.{/i}
lines.zh: : 到头来，我看见你们俩蜷在一起。我听见你说想回他的房间。而且我对{i}他{/i}早就有怀疑了。

lines.en: : I just never thought in a million years it would be {i}you{/i} I’d have to confront about it. You were like a sister to me.
lines.zh: : 我只是做梦都没想到，要摊牌的对象会是你。你对我{i}来{/i}说就像亲姐妹一样。

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront22
: And...you’re like one to me. Which is exactly why I didn’t want to do anything to hurt you...
lines.zh: : 而……你对我来说也一样。这正是我不想做任何伤害你的事的原因……

lines.en: : Well, it’s very comforting to hear that the only thing preventing you from fucking my boyfriend is “how much you care about me.” But I’ve gotta say, Yumi — that’s not a great best-case scenario.
lines.zh: : 哦，听到「唯一阻止你操我男朋友的东西是你有多在乎我」，我真他妈的欣慰啊。但我得说，Yumi——这可算不上什么最好的情况。

lines.en: : Because even {i}if{/i} everything you said is totally honest, which I highly doubt it is, you’ve {i}still{/i} been hiding shit from me.
lines.zh: : 因为{i}就算{/i}你说的全是实话，而我对此深表怀疑，你也{i}一直{/i}在瞒着我。

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront23
: I {i}love{/i} him. You got that? In a way you never could and never {i}will{/i} so long as I’m in the picture.
lines.zh: : 我{i}爱{/i}他。听明白了吗？是以一种你永远做不到、只要我还在{i}就{/i}永远做不到的方式。

lines.en: : And you want to know what’s really crazy? I’d {i}still{/i} love him even if he fucked you a hundred times that night because {i}you{/i} probably begged for it.
lines.zh: : 而且你想知道真正疯狂的是什么吗？就算他那天晚上操了你一百次，我{i}照样{/i}爱他，因为大概是{i}你{/i}求着他干的。

lines.en: : You’re fucking delusional, Chika...
lines.zh: : 你他妈的是疯了吧，Chika……

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront24
: I know that! I fucking know that already, Yumi! But no amount of mentally preparing myself and tricking myself into thinking I have a perfect relationship could have prepared me for {i}this!{/i}
lines.zh: : 我知道！我他妈的早就知道了，Yumi！可不管我怎么给自己做心理建设、怎么骗自己说我的恋情完美无缺，都不足以让我面对{i}这件事{/i}！

lines.en: : Why didn’t you just tell me?! About the kiss?! About the storm?! About any of it?! I gave you plenty of time to try and salvage this and you did nothing!
lines.zh: : 你为什么就是不告诉我？！关于那个吻？！关于那场暴风雨？！关于任何一件？！我给了你那么多时间来补救，你什么都没做！

lines.en: : Bitch, I fucking tried to. But you’ve been ignoring me ever since the goddamn beach and now I know why.
lines.zh: : 死丫头，我他妈的试过了。可从海滩那次之后你就一直不理我，现在我知道为什么了。

lines.en: : Right, well...that still doesn’t explain the kissing thing. And the going back to his room thing. And the millions of other things I’m mad at you about right now.
lines.zh: : 行，那么……接吻的事还是没解释清楚。回他房间的事也是。还有我现在对你生气的一大堆别的事。

lines.en: : And that’s...fair. You’re right in saying that even the best-case scenario sucks. But shouldn’t you be mad at {i}him{/i} too? {i}Not{/i} the gullible teenager who got swept up in the moment?
lines.zh: : 这……公平。你说得对，就算是最好的情况也很烂。可你不该也生{i}他{/i}的气吗？{i}而不是{/i}冲着那个被气氛冲昏头的傻丫头？

lines.en: : I {i}am{/i} mad at him! I’m mad at everyone! But there’s no one I’m madder at than {i}myself{/i} for taking this long to figure it all out!
lines.zh: : 我{i}是{/i}在生他的气！我谁的气都在生！但我最气的是{i}我自己{/i}——居然花了这么久才想明白这一切！

lines.en: : As someone being held against a fuckin’ railing right now, I think I’m gonna have to say you’re a little bit madder at me than you are at yourself.
lines.zh: : 作为一个现在正被按在栏杆上的人，我得说你对我生的气可比对你自己的大一点。

lines.en: : As the person {i}holding{/i} you against that fucking railing right now, I think I’m gonna ask you not to make jokes. This shit is unforgivable, Yumi. How would {i}you{/i} feel if you were in my shoes?
lines.zh: : 作为现在正把你{i}按{/i}在那该死的栏杆上的人，我请你别开玩笑。这事不可原谅，Yumi。换成是{i}你{/i}，你会怎么想？

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront25
: I don’t fuckin’ know, Chika...That’s just another reason why I try to stay away from all of this bullshit “romance” garbage. Shit’s just a tragedy waiting to happen.
lines.zh: : 我他妈的不知道，Chika……这也是我为什么尽量不碰这些「恋爱」垃圾的另一个原因。这种事就是一场随时会发生的悲剧。

lines.en: : Well, unfortunately, we can’t all be aloof and heartless lone wolves like you.
lines.zh: : 唉，可惜我们没法都像你一样，做个冷漠无情的独行侠。

lines.en: : You at least gonna talk to him about it? Or will pushing me off of your fuckin’ balcony be all you need to get this shit out of your system?
lines.zh: : 你至少会去跟他谈谈吧？还是说把我从你家阳台上推下去就够你出气了？

lines.en: : He’s next. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 他是下一个。别担心。

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront26
: Can I be the one to call him over then?
lines.zh: : 那我能来打这个电话叫他过来吗？

lines.en: : Why? Need some time to make sure you two have the same story?
lines.zh: : 为什么？需要时间对一下口供？

lines.en: : I’ll put it on fuckin’ speaker if you want. I don’t need to rehearse shit when everything I’ve said is the truth.
lines.zh: : 你要是愿意我可以开他妈的免提。我说的全是实话，不需要排练什么。

lines.en: : And unless that douchebag plans on lying to you, which I wouldn’t put past him, he’ll tell you the same goddamn thing I did.
lines.zh: : 而且除非那个混蛋打算骗你——他干得出来——否则他会跟你说的跟我一模一样。

lines.en: : Guess it won’t change shit even if he {i}does{/i} though, right? Since it seems like you’ve already made up your mind about how much I fucking suck.
lines.zh: : 就算他{i}真{/i}这么说，大概也改变不了什么吧？毕竟你似乎已经打定主意认定我有多他妈的烂了。

lines.en: scene chikayumiconfront27
: I never meant to hurt you, Chika.
lines.zh: : 我从没想过要伤害你，Chika。

lines.en: : I just ain’t good at havin’ feelings.
lines.zh: : 我只是不擅长处理感情。

lines.en: scene black
: Call him.
lines.zh: : 打电话给他。

lines.en: : Now?
lines.zh: : 现在？

lines.en: : Now.
lines.zh: : 现在。

lines.en: scene sky
: Wow, what a nice day. I can’t wait for everything to turn to shit.
lines.zh: : 哇，多好的一天啊。我迫不及待地等着一切变成一团狗屎。

lines.en: My phone begins to ring. And not a second too late.
lines.zh: 我的电话开始响。来得正是时候。

lines.en: : Hello?
: You need to get your fuckin’ ass to Chika’s place right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在立刻把你他妈的屁股挪到 Chika 家来。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because she saw us on the beach and now thinks you’re cheating on her {i}with me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 因为她看到我们在海滩上，现在以为你背着{i}我{/i}跟她劈腿。

lines.en: : Can you just come clear this up, please? I don’t know how to fuckin’ deal with her right now. And chances are I ain’t gonna be allowed here again for a long ass time, so...
lines.zh: : 你能不能过来把事情说清楚，拜托？我现在真不知道该怎么对付她。而且我很可能很长一段时间都不能再来这儿了，所以……

lines.en: : It’d be cool if you could try and set shit straight after all the fuckin’ torment you’ve inflicted on me these past however many school years it’s been.
lines.zh: : 你要是能在这些该死的学年里折磨我之后试着把事情掰正，那就再好不过了。

lines.en: : {i}Give me the phone.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}把电话给我。{/i}

lines.en: : Here’s Chika. Good luck.
lines.zh: : 这是 Chika。祝你好运。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Are you coming over? Or are you going to run away like a little {i}bitch{/i} just like you’ve been doing for months now?
lines.zh: : 你过来吗？还是要像这几个月以来那样，像个{i}没种的东西{/i}一样逃走？

lines.en: scene black
: Yeah, I’m on my way.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我在路上了。

lines.en: : Cool. Here’s Yumi again.
lines.zh: : 好。Yumi 再接。

lines.en: : Bye.
lines.zh: : 拜拜。

lines.en: Yumi hangs up the phone.
lines.zh: Yumi 挂断了电话。

lines.en: I don’t blame her.
lines.zh: 我不怪她。

lines.en: I just feel bad for getting her involved in one more aspect of a life I never wanted.
lines.zh: 我只是很抱歉，又把她卷进了一个我从没想要的人生的又一个侧面。
